title: Special Road Fund, Motor Vehicle User's Charge (Mvuc) As Per R.A. 11239, Solar Street Lights Installation and Application, Maharlika Highway Section, San Miguel, Bulacan
description: CONVERGENCE AND SPECIAL SUPPORT PROGRAM - SPECIAL ROAD FUND - MOTOR VEHICLE USER'S CHARGE (MVUC) AS PER R.A. 11239 - SOLAR STREET LIGHTS INSTALLATION AND APPLICATION, MAHARLIKA HIGHWAY SECTION, SAN MIGUEL, BULACAN
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.

reasons.title: A bidder is named in an official action
reasons.detail: TOPNOTCH CATALYST BUILDERS INC.: named in an official action on 25CC0148, status "referred" (2025-11-04; as reported)
reasons.evidence: A referral, charge, audit finding or suspension compiled by the team from a public source; status as reported.
checks: Open the source and confirm it names this firm, with the status word used (referred, charged, filed).
Note the date; check for later developments (dismissal, conviction, lifting of a suspension).

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: Topnotch Catalyst Builders Inc. (winner): 1 of 47 earlier road contracts terminated; Newbig Four J Construction Inc.: 8 of 179 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

reasons.title: Very fast award after bid opening
reasons.detail: Award made 7 days after the bid deadline (past road contracts awarded this fast had about twice the odds of termination)
reasons.evidence: Awards within 8 days of bid opening had about 2.1 times the odds of termination.
checks: Compare the bid-opening date with the Notice of Award date.
Ask whether post-qualification (checking the winner's documents and capacity) could be done that fast.

reasons.title: Citizen inspectors rated the winner's other work unsatisfactory
reasons.detail: TOPNOTCH CATALYST BUILDERS INC. has 1 project(s) rated unsatisfactory by Bisto citizen site inspectors
reasons.evidence: From Bisto Proyekto volunteer site inspections.
checks: Open the inspections of the winner's other projects on bisto.ph.

tests.text: TOPNOTCH CATALYST BUILDERS INC.: named in the 2025-26 flood-control investigations (officer: Eumir S. Villanueva, subpoenaed)
